side_effect: bladder cancer risk with prolonged use
injection site reactions (pain, redness, swelling, lipodystrophy)
Hepatic enzyme elevations (liver function monitoring required)
bloating — these are dose-related and often decrease over time
Cardiovascular: increased risk of MI and stroke
fatigue (common, reduced by folic acid supplementation)
Hepatotoxicity: liver fibrosis/cirrhosis with cumulative doses
Ophthalmologic: retinal toxicity/maculopathy (irreversible with long-term use, dose-dependent)
Bone marrow suppression: pancytopenia with overdose or in renal impairment
